lines: Before breakfast, Mira, Sol and Tavi met in the star room. The Star Door was shut.
A note slid through the letter box and landed beside Mira's boots.
Mira bent down, picked up the note and opened it.
I found a note! It says: Find nothing. Five clues will show the way.
Find nothing? That sounds very strange. I want to see what the clues show us!
Let's stay together and check everything we find. First, can you spot Mira's note?
You found the note. Look at the five empty star shapes at the top. They have no gold stars in them yet. Each checked clue will fill one. The first arrow is glowing beside the parcel!
Mira carried the note. The three friends followed its gold arrow across the room. It pointed to a parcel.
I opened the parcel. My brown teddy is inside. There is my toy!
The first clue says to move the teddy. Tap the toy to lift it out. Then tap the box and look inside.
You moved the teddy outside and looked inside. The box is empty. Empty means there is no toy inside this box. The box is still here.
The box was empty, but it was still a box. They had not found a thing called nothing. A gold star appeared on the map, and a blue door opened.
Mira carried the note through the doorway. Sol and Tavi followed her into a room with three big bells.
Hello! I am Nori. I listen for tiny sounds. May I help you check the bell room?
Yes, please. The note asks us to find nothing. The first room showed us a box. Let's see what this room shows us.
The wind has stopped, and the big bell is not moving. Hold the bell picture while we stay very quiet and listen.
The bell did not ring while we listened. I heard my breath, and the bell stayed right there. We found a quiet bell, not a thing called nothing.
The bell did not ring, but it was still there. The second star lit, and another blue door opened into a room filled with paper.
I found a white card on this table. Look, there are no marks on it yet.
Touch the card. You may draw a mark, or choose Leave blank so the card keeps no marks.
If you drew, the mark and the card are here. If you left it blank, blank means there is no mark on this card. The card is still here either way.
The card stayed there with or without a mark. The third star lit. Then seven wall tiles lit up, one after another.
Each glowing tile shows one letter. Read them from left to right with me!
The seven letters spell the word nothing. We can see and read it. Nothing is the word on the tiles. It is a word, not a thing.
The written word stayed on the tiles, so the fourth star lit. A gold arrow appeared on the floor and led the friends to a red curtain.
My teddy rolled out of my bag! It crossed the floor and went behind the curtain. I saw where it went, but I cannot see it now!
Slide the curtain slowly. Let's see what is behind it.
There is the teddy. Hidden means the curtain blocked it from our view. The toy did not disappear. Opening the curtain let us see it again.
Opening the curtain showed the teddy, so the fifth star lit. All five bright stars turned together, and the Star Door opened.
Behind the Star Door were two small doors. Door A had a white card on its shelf. Door B had an empty shelf.
My note still says, Find nothing. Tap both small doors. We must look at each one before we answer.
Door A showed a card. Door B showed an empty shelf. Neither door showed a thing called nothing.
The friends solved the note's puzzle. Mira folded the note. Everyone carried the five-star map into the library before going home.
Before we put the map away, let's remember the first clue. Which thing became empty after you moved Sol's teddy outside?
The box became empty after the teddy moved outside, but the box stayed in the room. We checked every clue. We found things, sounds and a written word, but no thing called nothing.
